description: This Java source file defines a utility Android IntentService class, UtilityService, that manages background operations such as geofence handling, location updates, notification management, and communication with wearable devices within the XYZTouristAttractions Android app. It includes methods for adding geofences, handling geofence transitions, requesting and processing location updates, clearing notifications, and transferring data to wearables.

classes.name: UtilityService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that performs background tasks like geofence management, location updates, and communication with wearable devices within the XYZTouristAttractions app.

methods.name: getLocationUpdatedIntentFilter
methods.description: Returns an IntentFilter for the ACTION_LOCATION_UPDATED broadcast.

methods.name: triggerWearTest
methods.description: Starts the service with an intent to trigger a wear test, optionally with a micro app.

methods.name: addGeofences
methods.description: Starts the service to add geofences.

methods.name: requestLocation
methods.description: Starts the service to request location updates.

methods.name: clearNotification
methods.description: Starts the service to clear the device notification.

methods.name: getClearRemoteNotificationsIntent
methods.description: Returns an intent to trigger clearing remote notifications.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Main handler that processes intents based on action, delegating to specific internal methods.

methods.name: addGeofencesInternal
methods.description: Adds geofences through Google Play Services.

methods.name: geofenceTriggered
methods.description: Handles geofence transition events, showing or clearing notifications accordingly.

methods.name: requestLocationInternal
methods.description: Requests a location update using Google Play Services API.

methods.name: locationUpdated
methods.description: Handles location update results, stores location, and broadcasts updates.

methods.name: clearRemoteNotifications
methods.description: Clears remote notifications by sending messages to wearables.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Constructs and displays a notification for a tourist attraction; can trigger a micro app or enhanced notifications with pages.

methods.name: sendDataToWearable
methods.description: Transfers attraction data and images to a connected wearable device using DataApi.
